The installed125-game library01 proof completed indexed caching and actual unindexed SIGTERM/retry with all125 games ready and the first60 never refetched, then failed its timing predicate. Of876 recorded local-provider requests, exactly one arrival gap is0.258471262seconds against the .26second test floor (achievementsets33 → gameid34). The source throttles at RequestThrottle.wait before request construction, not at the server handler. Arrival timestamp jitter does not independently prove a product throttle defect; retain the failure and verify the actual pacing point.

The outer isolation check also found the guest default route restored after a one-time deletion. This is not durable isolation. The provider was configured to loopback; no hosted-account claim is made. Later persisted-pause/429 controls were not reached.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — disposable candidate15 guest, native installed helper and125 synthetic iNES files, local provider in a dedicated network namespace. No personal cloud, real account or physical device.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Preserve failed01 four-channel1 results, unchanged10 input seals, provider timestamps and actual owner/guest cleanup; classify the exact failure without relabeling it PASS.
- [x] Fresh isolated proof observes installed RequestThrottle.wait completion without replacing product functions or production .3second/50game/30second constants; verify per-process gate intervals and request count. Keep provider-arrival intervals as separate observations and a deliberate fast-timestamp negative control for the observer predicate.
- [x] The proof and all helper children share a private loopback-only network namespace with no IPv4/IPv6 default route; the VM network manager cannot add a route to it. Retain namespace and route observations before/after plus loopback HTTP success.
- [x] Installed indexed/unindexed125, actual interruption/retry, byte preservation/no refetch, both production batch cooldowns, persisted pause, real429 Retry-After/restart and upstream100-budget queue control all pass; unchanged installed hashes, four completion channels and actual cleanup verified.

Already written: no product repair is yet justified by this timing observation. All product bytes remain frozen. Failed owner and guest disk are retained; only QA instrumentation/isolation changes in a fresh owner. Refs #361, #471, #395.

Private loopback-only namespace is unchanged before/after. Failed01 remains failed under#474; no product throttle repair was needed. Exact proof and independent arithmetic are retained in p4-library-fixes-02 and library02-acceptance-01.

Code trace: retained whole-library-installed.py and sitecustomize.py observe RequestThrottle.wait return without replacing it; whole-library-proof.py launches the entire local provider/helper process group inside unshare --net. Product source and timers are unchanged. Closure follows evidence publication.
